items.question: What establishes recognition for dwellings or forms whose nature is previously unknown?
premises: Some dwellings or forms lack a previously known identity.
A designation can be applied on the basis of a name.
items.inference: Therefore, an unknown dwelling or form becomes well-known through its name.
uncertainties: The exact scope of vāstu in this ritual context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: In the case of dwellings or forms whose nature is unknown, it should become well-known by its name.
